name: Devyani International Limited
summary: Devyani International Limited develops, manages, and operates quick service restaurants and food courts in India, Nepal, Nigeria, Thailand, and internationally. It operates outlets under the KFC, Pizza Hut, Costa Coffee, Vaango and other brands. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Gurugram, India. Devyani International Limited is a subsidiary of RJ Corp Limited.
